description: Factum-F conformance test vectors. Language-agnostic: any Factum implementation (Rust, Python, TS, etc.) should produce identical canonical serialization for these inputs.
charset_policy: v0.1-alpha: Entity and Symbol identifiers are ASCII-only ([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*). Unicode support and NFC normalization are deferred to a future spec version.

positive_vectors.expected_canonical: canonical serialization of parse(input). The implementation must: parse(input) → serialize(result) → compare against expected_canonical. Two implementations that both pass are structurally identical.

negative_vectors.input: Factum-F source string that should fail to parse
negative_vectors.error_class: categorized error type (see error taxonomy below)

error_taxonomy: NamedArgBeforePositional — positional arg appears after a named arg
MissingModelRef — Extracted provenance lacks model field
UnterminatedString — string literal without closing quote
UnexpectedToken — token appears where another was expected
